open-on-the-hype.title: Open on the hype
open-on-the-hype.keywords: twenty times, every feed, keynote, vendor deck
open-on-the-hype.script: You have seen the line. Become twenty times more productive with AI. It is on every feed, in every keynote, in every vendor deck. Maybe you even believed it for a day or two.

bridge-to-the-room.title: Bridge to the room
bridge-to-the-room.script: Then you sat down and tried it yourself, and you know how that went. So why? Today I want to look at exactly that.
